title: 동료 승진 축하하기: 승진했다고 들었어요!
objective: Congratulate someone and pass on news or messages with -다고.
summary: Coworkers congratulate each other on a promotion and an exam pass, using -다고.
setting: An office break room. Jisu congratulates her coworker Minho on his promotion.

task.title: Share and celebrate news
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to fill in, choose, put words in order, or write short Korean answers.

words.meaning: I heard that... Past: -았/었다고. Verb, now or future: -ㄴ/는다고. Adjective: -다고.
words.exampleMeaning: I heard that company's interviews are hard.
My older sister was promoted to team leader this year.

words.meaning: to pass (an exam, interview, or school entry)
words.exampleMeaning: I passed the interview, so I start work next month.

words.meaning: that's great (reacting to someone's good news)
words.exampleMeaning: You found a place? That's great.
We went on a trip to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary.

words.meaning: to treat people (to a meal or drinks), usually to celebrate
words.exampleMeaning: When I get my first paycheck, it's my treat.

dialogue.korean: 민호 씨, 이번에 과장으로 승진했다고 들었어요. 축하해요!
dialogue.meaning: Minho, I heard you were promoted to manager. Congratulations!

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 아직 실감이 안 나요. 참, 지수 씨 동생도 시험에 합격했다면서요?
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. It doesn't feel real yet. Oh, by the way, I heard your younger brother passed his exam too?
Yes, he called yesterday to say he passed.

dialogue.korean: 와, 정말 잘됐네요! 동생한테 축하한다고 전해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Wow, that's great news! Please tell him I said congratulations.

dialogue.korean: 네, 꼭 전할게요. 그럼 오늘 점심은 승진 기념으로 민호 씨가 사는 거죠?
dialogue.meaning: Sure, I'll tell him. So lunch today is on you, to celebrate your promotion, right?

exercises: Fill in the blank with the past form + -다고 (-았/었다고): ① 친구가 장학금을 ____ 들었어요. (받다) ② 사촌이 의대에 ____ 연락이 왔어요. (붙다) ③ 우리 팀장님이 부장이 ____ 들었어요. (되다)
Choose the best reply: A: 저 이번에 면접 붙었어요! (a) 정말 아쉽네요. (b) 정말 잘됐네요! 축하해요. (c) 결과 나오면 알려 주세요.
Put the words in order: 들었어요 / 승진한다고 / 다음 달에 / 김 대리님이
Write in Korean: You just passed an exam. Tell your friends you will treat them to celebrate. Use 기념으로 and 한턱내다.
answers: ① 받았다고 ② 붙었다고 ③ 됐다고 (되었다고)
김 대리님이 다음 달에 승진한다고 들었어요. (다음 달에 김 대리님이 승진한다고 들었어요.)
합격 기념으로 제가 한턱낼게요. (오늘은 합격 기념으로 제가 한턱낼게요.)
